opportunity_for_improvement: The Non-teaching personnel have limited professional membership in their respective area field of specialization and expertise.
recommendation_text: Non-Teaching Personnel should be continuously encouraged to actively participate by becoming active members of their respective professional organization. Moreover, NTP should also be encouraged to pursue and finish their graduate studies.

opportunity_for_improvement: The psychological test available in the Guidance Office were purely can be administered to students physically. There is a need to adapt in the present situations that availability of online psychological testing be made available.
recommendation_text: Purchasing of psychological tests which can be administered through online is deemed necessary so that students can still avail testing services even using online platforms. Likewise, purchasing of aptitude test is also deemed necessary to determine aptitude of students across all programs and correlate it with students’ academic performance.

opportunity_for_improvement: Results of the psychological test being administered to students is not properly utilized by the faculty and administrators.
recommendation_text: The results of the different psychological test given by the Guidance Office to the students can be used to by faculty and administrators to meet student needs and for intensification of the curricular programs the Nursing program.

opportunity_for_improvement: Training Needs Analysis was not evident for Non-Teaching Personnel as basis for their employee’s development.
recommendation_text: The conduct of Training Needs Analysis for Non-Teaching Personnel is deemed necessary to serve as the basis in the formulation of Non-Teaching Personnel Development Program.

opportunity_for_improvement: The Customer Satisfaction Survey were not evident although some of the units of the student services have their own feedback form.
recommendation_text: Customer Satisfaction Survey should be conducted to serve as the basis of evaluation for all the student services units.

opportunity_for_improvement: The consultation room being provided to students does not have privacy.
recommendation_text: Provision of consultation room with privacy should be observed and schedules of faculty availability for consultation should be posted in the consultation room.

opportunity_for_improvement: Digitization of the records found in the registrar’s office should be continuously observe. Moreover, the storage room in the registrar’s office should be fireproof and additional storage should be provided for future considerations.
recommendation_text: Scanning of all the students records in the registrars is deemed necessary. Likewise, a more spacious storage and fireproof rooms for students’ records must be done.

opportunity_for_improvement: Students, faculty, and non -teaching personnel participation in the different outreach / extension activities of the university in all programs were still limited.
recommendation_text: A re-orientation program can be provided to emphasize on the importance active participation on community extension and outreach activities of the department.

opportunity_for_improvement: Researches on community outreach and extension services of the program needs to be enhance that would give importance on impact and sustainability.
recommendation_text: A research on the outreach /community extension can be made specific on the program most specially for community partners most specially to communities which had been partners for more than 5 years.

opportunity_for_improvement: Alumni participation should be encouraged in the different outreach and community extension activities of all the programs.
recommendation_text: Alumni could be invited as resource person or speaker in the different webinars/ seminars provided by the college in line with the expertise of the alumni.

opportunity_for_improvement: In the plan of activities of the community outreach and extension coordinator monitoring, evaluating of the different activities e.g. donations of materials, equipment’s should be properly accounted for.
recommendation_text: Device a way on how to properly monitor, evaluate the different activities such as donation provided to the partner foundation e.g. donation of materials, equipment so that this would be properly accounted for. For example, maintaining a logbook or making reports of inventory of the materials donated to the partner foundation.

opportunity_for_improvement: There was no availability of continuing and sustainable programs intended for the adopted communities.
recommendation_text: Sustainable outreach programs should be implemented for the adopted communities.

opportunity_for_improvement: There was limited evidence of the assessment as to the effectiveness of the community service and the involvement of the members of the whole academic community.
recommendation_text: It is recommended that the school assess the effectiveness of the community service and the involvement of the members of the whole academic community as to gauge the effectiveness and importance of the program to the community being served.

opportunity_for_improvement: Training for skills-development that may generate income for the residents of the adopted community needs to be strengthen.
recommendation_text: Skills-development training programs for the residents of the adopted community may be conducted by the faculty, students and NTP to develop their self-sufficiency.

opportunity_for_improvement: There was minimal linkage with non-government agencies for effective community service.
recommendation_text: The school may initiate community outreach programs that may link the non-government agencies for better service to the residents of the adopted community.

opportunity_for_improvement: Records did not show the annual safety certificate issued by professional civil, electrical, mechanical, and electronics engineers to ensure the safety of all the structures, electrical, mechanical, and electronics installations of the entire STIWNU campus.
recommendation_text: The office of the building engineer at STIWNU should require an annual inspection and certification issued by professional engineers to ensure the safety of lives and properties of the STIWNU campus.

opportunity_for_improvement: It was noted that there was no easy and direct access to the comfort rooms in some administrative offices and faculty rooms.
recommendation_text: There should be convenient, safe, and direct access for faculty and administrative staff to the comfort rooms to promote a more private answer to some urgent personal necessity.

opportunity_for_improvement:
The flow of traffic in the corridors was passively monitored, and directional flow did not show the proper movement of students along the corridor, specifically during peak and in-between periods.
It was noted that there was no established student canteen inside the campus to meet the food and nutritional needs of the faculty, staff, and students.
recommendation_text:
The flow of traffic in the corridors should be actively monitored to promote direct, systematic movement of traffic and no impeded crowd along the corridors during peak periods.
The school should provide a very established and comfortable student canteen inside the campus to meet the food and nutritional needs of the faculty, staff, and students.

opportunity_for_improvement: The main entrance of STI WNU was not well-lighted, ventilated, or insulated.
recommendation_text: The building engineering, as part of the development plan for the campus, should initiate modification and beautification at the main entrance of the STIWNU campus to ensure a very attractive aesthetic internal view and a perfectly insulated environment.

opportunity_for_improvement: Greening and landscaping inside the STIWNU campus were not properly maintained and developed.
recommendation_text: To mirror the school’s concern for the environment, greening and landscaping should be part of the campus development plan to promote a very healthy and conducive learning environment for the students.

opportunity_for_improvement: Broken tiles in some classrooms, an unpaved and uneven portion on the ground floor near the students’ lounge, and dilapidated wooden classroom partitions and ceilings were noted.
recommendation_text: Broken tiles in some classrooms, an unpaved and uneven portion on the ground floor near the students’ lounge, and dilapidated wooden classroom partitions and ceilings should be immediately rehabilitated to ensure the safety of everyone.

opportunity_for_improvement: Unpleasant odor and cleanliness in students' comfort rooms were not properly maintained.
recommendation_text: There should be constant running water, especially in male urinals and proper maintenance of the cleanliness of comfort rooms should be prioritized to ensure a safe and hygienic learning environment of the students.

opportunity_for_improvement: The communication process between the finance department and colleges/departments regarding the status of budget requests should be improved. It is crucial to provide regular updates on the progress of these requests, as well as any challenges that arise during the processing phase. This will ensure that all parties involved are aware of the request's current state and can take necessary actions to address any issues that may arise.
recommendation_text: Regular updates on the status of each request should be proactively communicated by finance department to the respective colleges and departments. The finance department should create a system to track all budget requests from colleges and departments. This system should allow for easy monitoring of the status of each request, including any delays or challenges encountered during processing.

opportunity_for_improvement: Peer evaluation should be enhanced during the performance evaluation process. This will give opportunities for employees to receive feedback and learn from their colleagues.
recommendation_text: To address this, it is recommended to that performance evaluation process be reviewed to improve the system and to provide a more holistic and well-rounded assessment of employee performance.
action_taken: The Academics and Human Resource Management Office is currently updating the faculty and non-teaching personnel performance evaluation tool. This will allow a 360-degree feedback mechanism involving self, peer, and superior evaluations. The revised tool aims to ensure a fair and comprehensive assessment of employees’ competencies, behavior, and contributions, thereby fostering continuous professional growth and development.

opportunity_for_improvement: Evaluation of processes should be conducted as scheduled despite the number of academic and non-academic activities of the school that the management is involved with. Additionally, administrative processes such as student admissions, financial management, and resource allocation were not consistently evaluated to ensure compliance with institutional policies and external regulatory requirements.
recommendation_text:
The institution should develop a schedule for conducting internal quality assurance reviews that aligns with the academic programs' accreditation cycles and external regulatory requirements. This will ensure that academic programs are reviewed on a regular basis to assess their compliance with learning outcomes, validity and reliability of assessments, and faculty professional development.

The institution should develop a process for evaluating administrative processes such as student admissions, financial management, and resource allocation to ensure compliance with institutional policies and external regulatory requirements. This process should be regularly reviewed and updated to ensure its effectiveness.
action_taken:
The Quality Assurance Office, in coordination with the Vice President for Academic Affairs and the respective departments, has developed a monitoring schedule aligned with accreditation timelines and institutional calendars. In addition, all divisions are required to submit performance reports to ensure accountability and continuous process improvement.
Regular internal quality audits are being conducted to assess compliance with institutional policies, academic standards, and regulatory requirements. Also, STI West Negros University submits itself to external audits (ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 21001:2018) to ensure that its management systems and educational processes adhere to international standards of quality and effectiveness. These audits provide valuable feedback for continuous improvement, promote operational efficiency, and strengthen the institution’s commitment to excellence in governance and service delivery.

Internal Audit Report sample
Annual Performance Report of departments.

opportunity_for_improvement: Currently, some documents are simply placed on open shelves without any proper organization or filing system. This haphazard storage method leaves these important documents vulnerable to theft, damage, or misplacement.
recommendation_text:
The college may implement a thorough filing system with clear labeling, categorization, and storage guidelines. This system should be easily accessible and searchable to authorized personnel, and should also include a backup storage solution for emergencies and disasters.

Locked cabinets or safes, with restricted access for authorized personnel only may be provided. 
Regular maintenance and inventory checks should be conducted to ensure all documents are accounted for and in good condition, with any missing or damaged documents immediately reported and replaced.
